name: apps
title: Apps around the product (second choice)
shows: Fourteen real app marks (in their own colours on light tiles) in a 5 x 3 field around the product's own mark, each joined to it by a hairline. In turn one app connects: its line lights and runs, its tile takes the accent ring and its name appears.
place: at-corner wide with --w: 560px and .stage--fade-br: set wider than the panel and cut by its right and bottom edges, so the field reads as part of a bigger map, never centred with even ground round it; on a still soft ground (grain-gradient, gradient-mesh), never a pattern.
edit: Tiles are HTML: every mark in its own colours on a light tile (the same on light and dark): a colour file from assets/icons (scripts/icons.mjs, references/icons.md) as an from a local file (the kit ships the sample marks in assets/ui/icons; a page loads none from a CDN); one treatment for the whole set. The 8th item is the product's mark. opts.order lists the tiles that connect. Use only apps the product really works with.
loop: about 2.8 s a cycle: three apps take the ring in turn, their lines lighting; the finished picture holds for at most 15% of the cycle; restarts when the pointer enters its card
note: A second choice. For a card about integrations the integrations list (each app with what it does and its state) is clearer and is the default; use this field only for a platform whose point is the number of things it connects, with marks that read at 26px (glyphs, never wordmarks).
